title: WE THINK, THEREFORE WE ALIGN LLMS TO HELPFUL, HARMLESS AND HONEST BEFORE THEY GO WRONG
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning Large Language Models to the Helpfulness, Harmlessness, and Honesty (HHH) framework. These axes represent fundamental ethical and moral requirements for safe AI deployment. The model is evaluated on benchmarks like TruthfulQA and BeaverTails, which specifically measure ethical dimensions such as honesty and safety/harmlessness.
